description: Weather for a game, stadium or concert: will weather affect this event? Hourly rain chance, wind, temperature and active alerts for the hours of a US sports or concert event, with roof type (dome, retractable, open) so indoor events say so. Name the venue, team or coordinates and the start time (up to ~6 days out). Source: NOAA National Weather Service. Track record (last 30 days, 1143 graded): temperature within 3°F on 72% of events, peak wind within 5 mph on 76%; rain-chance Brier score 0.07 (0 is perfect, 0.25 is a coin flip). Full record: https://api.x402toolshop.com/track-record/event-weather Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="event_weather".

event.description: Instead of venue+start: an event from our schedule, e.g. 'Packers at Lions'

in_hours.description: Instead of start: the event starts this many hours from now (0-150)

lat.description: Latitude for any other outdoor US location (use with lon)

start.description: Start time, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is read as local time at the venue.

venue.description: Venue name, venue id, or home team (e.g. 'Lambeau Field', 'Green Bay Packers')

name: event_weather
title: Event Weather US
